# hostwarden_host (Data Source)

Look up a registered Hostwarden host by name, with its live status.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `address` (String)
- `build` (String) ESXi build number.
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether Hostwarden reaches the host. The attributes below are empty when it does not.
- `cpu_cores` (Number)
- `cpu_model` (String) CPU model: hosts with different CPUs cannot exchange suspended VMs.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `license_name` (String)
- `maintenance_mode` (Boolean)
- `memory_total_mb` (Number)
- `ssh_enabled` (Boolean)
- `version` (String) ESXi version.
